$comment: G5 (0.3.78) single source for the family's cross-file FACTS.
A fact here is a statement that used to live in two or more tracked documents and
therefore drifted (0.3.77: the root README still claimed that sessions on other
presets keep the shared automation, and the agent README still claimed there is no
cordis base after bases.json grew one).
Rules of the table: every fact has exactly ONE home document; other documents CITE
the home (the `cites` entries) instead of restating it; a `must` entry marked
unique may appear in the home ONLY - a second copy anywhere in the tracked docs
fails verify-arch-guards rule N19. `machine` entries re-derive the statement from
the code/data that owns the value, so a changed value with a stale doc also fails.
Version history (CHANGELOG.md) is the REASON layer and is exempt from `forbid`: a
released version section records what was true then and is never rewritten.
packages/docs/** is gitignored (not a versionable surface): it may be a source of
material, never a home; the lib skips it by name.
